title: Autonomous AI Agent Mode Foundation
goal: Add an opt-in fully autonomous execution mode where the AI agent dispatches follow-up tasks, chains tool runs, and adapts the assessment plan without requiring operator approval for each step — while preserving all scope, safety, and kill-switch enforcement.
scope: Implement an autonomous_mode flag on the run model and a new run profile class 'autonomous-web' and 'autonomous-internal'. When autonomous_mode=true: (1) the post-task AI analysis callback (from backlog-41) automatically promotes pending AgentProposals to approved and queues them as real tasks without waiting for operator review, subject to scope enforcement and risk-tier limits; (2) passive and active proposals auto-execute; (3) intrusive proposals require a separate autonomous_intrusive_allowed flag (default false) — if not set, intrusive proposals are logged but not auto-dispatched; (4) a real-time agent activity feed shows each dispatched agent as a card (tool name, target, status, findings count) mirroring the Aikido 'Attacker #N' grid; (5) the kill switch immediately stops all queued autonomous tasks; (6) scope enforcement remains absolute — no target outside the approved allowlist is ever reached. Manual mode (current behavior) is unchanged and remains the default.
generation_reason: Competitor analysis shows Aikido deploys 96-800+ autonomous agents per assessment. AegisPT currently requires human approval for every AI proposal, limiting throughput and operator experience. An opt-in autonomous mode closes this gap while preserving the controlled approach as the default for enterprise/audit environments.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Autonomous dispatch of AI proposals only. Scope enforcement is absolute — no out-of-scope targets regardless of autonomous mode. The kill switch must immediately halt all queued autonomous tasks. Intrusive proposals never auto-execute without explicit autonomous_intrusive_allowed=true. Manual mode remains unchanged and is the default.

success_criteria: A run with autonomous_mode=true auto-dispatches passive and active AI proposals without operator approval.
Intrusive proposals are only auto-dispatched when autonomous_intrusive_allowed=true.
The kill switch immediately halts all queued autonomous tasks.
Scope enforcement rejects out-of-scope proposals regardless of autonomous mode.
An agent activity feed renders dispatched agents as cards showing tool, target, status, and finding count.
Manual mode (default) behavior is completely unchanged.
New autonomous-web and autonomous-internal run profiles exist.
Tests cover autonomous dispatch, kill-switch halt, scope rejection, and intrusive gate.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Autonomous mode dispatches proposals without operator review.
Kill switch halts all queued autonomous tasks immediately.
Scope enforcement rejects out-of-scope targets regardless of mode.

before_promotion: UI screen consolidation (backlog-59) is completed and logged.
Autonomous mode scope boundaries documented in docs/ai_pentesting_agent_scope_alignment.md.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with autonomous mode implementation, scope enforcement evidence, kill-switch test results.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with autonomous mode as opt-in capability.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: Auto-executing intrusive proposals without explicit flag
